name: Skid-Mounted & Packaged Units — Modular Equipment Packages

work_packages.note: Pad or steel module support; multi-point level survey for large skids
Heavy-lift/multi-point rig plan; set on levelling points
Full-bed or point grout; anchor to spec
Battery-limit piping, cable, duct and utility tie-ins between skid and plant
Re-connect any items removed for transport; vendor punch-list; re-align internal rotating gear
OEM field service engineer leads functional and performance test

activities: Accept module foundation/support steel with multi-point level
Confirm anchor pattern vs skid base
Verify access and lay-down for the setting lift
sequence.note: Large skids need a flat, level multi-point support or they twist and internal alignment is lost

activities: Receive skid; inspect for transit/preservation damage and loose-shipped items
Execute lift/setting per rig plan onto levelling points
Set on foundation over anchors
sequence.note: Loose-shipped items (removed for transport width/weight) logged for re-fit

activities: Level skid frame across all support points (no rack/twist)
Grout (full-bed or point) and cure
Final anchor torque
Re-check internal rotating-equipment alignment after setting
sequence.note: A skid can rack in transport/lift; internal pump/compressor alignment is re-verified once the frame is level and grouted

activities: Connect battery-limit process/utility piping to skid tie-in flanges
Re-fit loose-shipped piping/spools
Support tie-in piping independently
sequence.note: Tie-ins are at defined battery-limit points; skid-internal piping is pre-fabricated by vendor

activities: Land incoming power to skid distribution/MCC
Connect field/plant instrument and control tie-ins to the skid junction boxes / local panel
Earth/bond the skid frame
Re-terminate any cabling disconnected for transport
sequence.note: Skid usually has a local control panel; plant DCS ties into it at a defined interface

activities: Verify all loose-shipped items re-fitted
Vendor and site joint installation inspection
Mechanical completion against vendor checklist
sequence.note: Vendor sign-off that transport-removed items are restored is a key gate

activities: Hydrotest/leak-test the re-made tie-in joints (skid-internal already vendor-tested)
Flush utility connections into the skid
Loop-check plant-to-skid signals and interlocks
sequence.note: Do not re-test the vendor's internal package; test only the field-made connections

activities: Energise skid utilities (air, cooling, power, lube)
Vendor pre-checks: levels, preservation removal, protection
Local-panel I/O and interlock checks
sequence.note: Vendor field-service engineer typically must be on site before energising the package

activities: Vendor-led functional and performance run under warranty
Prove package-to-plant interlocks and trips live
Acceptance/performance test
sequence.note: Running without the OEM present often voids the package warranty

typical_relationships.before: Skid frame levelled across all support points and grouted
typical_relationships.reason: Transport and lifting can rack the frame; internal alignment only holds once the base is level and fixed

typical_relationships.before: All loose-shipped items re-fitted and cabling re-terminated
typical_relationships.reason: Items removed for transport must be restored or the package is incomplete and unsafe to run

typical_relationships.before: Battery-limit tie-in joints made and tested
typical_relationships.reason: The plant-to-skid interfaces must be leak-tight and looped before the package runs against the plant

typical_relationships.before: Skid utilities (power, air, cooling, lube) energised and clean
typical_relationships.reason: The package cannot function until its enabling utilities are live and within spec
OEM-supervised start protects the warranty and applies package-specific knowledge
The frame must be bonded before power is applied

interfaces.requirement: Setting REQUIRES a multi-point-level foundation/support steel with the correct anchor pattern
Commissioning REQUIRES battery-limit process/utility piping connected and tested to the skid tie-in points
Energisation REQUIRES incoming power terminated to the skid distribution/MCC
Integrated operation REQUIRES the plant control system tied into the skid local panel at the defined signal interface
Package function REQUIRES enabling utilities (instrument air, cooling water, N2/inert, lube) live and clean
Energisation REQUIRES the skid frame bonded to the earthing grid
Upstream/downstream process readiness REQUIRES connected units available for an integrated run

testing_requirements: Skid frame multi-point level record (no twist/rack)
Grout cure and anchor torque records
Internal rotating-equipment alignment re-check after setting
Re-made battery-limit tie-in joint hydrotest/leak test
Plant-to-skid signal loop-checks and interlock tests
commissioning_dependencies: Frame level, grouted, anchored; internal alignment re-verified
All loose-shipped items re-fitted and cabling re-terminated
Battery-limit tie-ins connected, tested and flushed
Skid power, air, cooling and lube utilities live and clean
Plant control tied into the skid panel and interlocks proven
Vendor field-service engineer available for warranty start
typical_exceptions: Small factory-tested packages ship complete — field scope is setting, tie-in and a functional check only
Weather-enclosed modules (PAUs) need no plant-room; they are self-contained
A package delivered fully assembled skips the loose-item re-fit and internal re-alignment steps
evidence: The package was energised and run before its transport-removed items were re-fitted and before the internal rotating gear was re-aligned on the levelled, grouted frame.
